verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak layout. The equal-width title bars from the original have become one oversized NEW YORK bar above two stubby SUBWAY and GUIDE bars, so the key word SUBWAY is demoted. NEW YORK's text is also indented further than the other two lines. The photo is cropped so the sign reads 'BWAY', and the diagonal grey/beige panels have broken into floating fragments with faint ghost shapes on the left. A pushes the title stack tight against the top edge and leaves the fragments hanging awkwardly mid-canvas. B gives the title a little more top margin and sits the fragments lower, so it is slightly less awkward.
